outcome: acceptance of immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive devices (PPIUD)
cohort: 373 systematically selected postnatal women who delivered at Bedele General Hospital, Chora Primary Hospital, Didesa Primary Hospital, and Chaweqa General Hospital in Ethiopia participated in the study.
finding: The acceptance rate of immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive devices (PPIUD) was very low, at 9.9%.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a significant factor associated with the acceptance of immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive devices.
